note: Curated by hand. A ticker that is not in the selected JSE universe is dropped by the build and counted, never invented.

themes.label: BANKS & FINANCIALS
themes.note: The large banks, the insurers and the asset managers. Net interest margin, credit losses and the SARB repo rate drive earnings; lenders carry a P/E and a P/B but no free cash flow.

themes.label: MINING & PLATINUM
themes.note: Gold, platinum-group metals, iron ore, coal and the diversified miners. The rand cost base, the platinum basket and Chinese steel demand are the swing factors.

themes.label: TELECOMS & MEDIA
themes.note: Mobile networks, fixed-line and the media houses. Data revenue and fintech attach rates are the growth lines; spectrum and load-shedding are the costs.

themes.label: RETAIL & CONSUMER
themes.note: Food, fashion, pharmacy and general retail. Volume growth, credit sales and the consumer cycle matter more than headline inflation.

themes.label: INDUSTRIALS
themes.note: Building materials, equipment, logistics and business services — the domestic capex and infrastructure read.

themes.label: ENERGY & CHEMICALS
themes.note: Sasol's synfuels and chemicals, the coal exporters and the industrial chemical names. Brent, the rand and the coal price are the three inputs.

themes.label: HEALTHCARE
themes.note: Private hospitals, pharmacies and pharmaceuticals. Demand is defensive; the risk is the medical-scheme reimbursement cycle.

themes.label: PROPERTY & REITS
themes.note: Listed real estate, from domestic REITs to the European and UK portfolios. Distribution growth and the bond yield are the valuation anchors.

themes.label: FOREIGN-SECONDARY LISTINGS
themes.note: The six JSE lines of foreign-domiciled issuers. Statements come from the primary exchange; the price is the JSE line and the cap is the global company total.
